rule.near_tie_basis: Reference |P(A) - P(B)|, fixed before this run from the 16-question smoke test, whose largest probability difference was 0.029. Those questions are part of this comparison.
adopt_if: all planned calls valid in both runs
same model, binary and server profile except the slot directory
prefix reuse verified on every call: cache_n equals the prefix tokens and cache_n plus prompt_n equals the prompt tokens
every letter flip has a reference margin below near_tie_margin
rule.otherwise: keep full re-encoding as the reference mechanism
rule.reported_not_tuned: Case-level selection and aggregate score changes are reported; they do not alter this rule.

verdict: adopt slot restore as the prefix mechanism for later iterations

repeatability.method: letter and exact largest probability difference against the same reference
